text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...Yeah. I'm okay. I'm calm.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Starting today, I'm staying true to my level.
I'll bloom properly right where I am—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright.
Let's go train."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
From Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: A change in training policy?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I took another look over the whole thing.
Yeah, I went over the whole thing and revised it

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's have a look.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...! W-What is this...?
Hasn't everything gotten way too laid-back here...?!)
choice_data_list: What do you think from your perspective, Luck?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ah, umm...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you've left me with quite a bit of leeway, haven't you?
Personally, I wouldn't mind if you
packed a bit more in."
choice_data_list: Still, with how you are now, you'll be fine with this.
Still, with how you are now, you'll be fine with this.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list: You're already strong enough
You're already plenty strong, after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer...?
What do you mean by that...?
choice_data_list: I've decided to live within my means too.
I decided to keep things modest and within my means too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: ..."Alright, that's enough out of you," right?
..."Alright, that's enough out of you," right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Shadow of Flowers
text_block_list.text:
“—Why are ya so shocked?
It's only natural, ain't it?”

text_block_list.name: Shadow of Flowers
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who said it, weren't you?
"I'm done."

text_block_list.name: Shadow of Flowers
text_block_list.text:
You just understood how I felt,
fair and square, Trainer.
You didn't do anything wrong.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Right.
I definitely said it... but...—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: It's been tough lately, so let's take more breaks.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—
choice_data_list: You've been pushing yourself hard, haven't you? But you'll be okay now.

text_block_list.name: Shadow of Flowers
text_block_list.text: Haaah. Trainer-san, you're really so kind. You look out for me so much.

text_block_list.name: Shadow of Flowers
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine. You've worked hard enough already.
No one's gonna complain.

text_block_list.name: Shadow of Flowers
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, they might even console you, ya know?
Saying, 'You did great going up against Almond Eye.'"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Even so, this is just... so sudden...!
choice_data_list: —Luck.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Stop...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Don't look at me... with those pitying eyes... please—)
choice_data_list: You've really worked hard up until now.
You've really done your best all this time.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: —You don't have to force yourself to be a queen anymore.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: ...Luck?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: No way... I totally hate this...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah did say that, it's true...!
Ah was the one who went, "Forget it already!"...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Even so...!! Even still...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I... I don't want Trainer... to ever think 'I've had enough of her' about me...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna be told “You don't have to be queen”...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Making her say something like that...!
I'm so uncool and pathetic, I can't forgive myself...!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
What's with that "live within your means" garbage?
What's with "I can shine bright enough here"...?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
What's with that "I'll yield the spotlight" crap?!
You absolute dumbass!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Don't act all cool!!
Stop playing smart!!!
Ya just ran away, didn'tcha?!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I was so scared of losing to Ai-san next time……!!
I hated the thought of losing my pride as Queen……!
I just didn't want to be humiliated—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ye just... gave up on playin' the straight man, didn't ye...?!!
choice_data_list: ...Then, what do you want to do?
...Then, what do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Tch, truth is, I still don't want to give up...!
I don't want to concede a single thing...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"It'd be mortifying to end like this...!!
I wanna be queen...!!
I wanna be the star of the show...!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: There's NO WAY I'm just gonna "forget it"!!!!!
choice_data_list: —I was waiting for that punchline!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: ...I'm glad. Thanks for calling me out honestly.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: True feelings, you say...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...! Could it be...?!
choice_data_list: Sorry, that wasn't a very good joke, was it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Then the truth is... you—
choice_data_list: There's never been a moment I didn't believe in you.
There's never been a moment I didn't believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I'll say it as many times as needed, if this trust can give her even a little confidence as a queen.
choice_data_list: You're a flower in full bloom through endurance, the strongest queen.
You are a flower that endures and blooms proudly—the strongest queen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I believe in her. No matter the adversity or the rival,
Lucky Lilac will endure and burst right through...!
choice_data_list: There's no way I'm saying "that's enough" either!
There's no way I'm saying "that's enough" either!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm, so sorry.
I caused you trouble by saying something so foolish.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I... lied to myself.
I was too scared to face Ai-san.
...Just to run away."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"B-But just now, when you told me I 'didn't have to be the Queen'...
I got so mad... I just couldn't hold it in—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"……I'll say it again.
I wanna be the queen.
I want to stand in the spotlight……!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to stop and say, 'This is where it ends.'
Even if there is a limit, I want to stand up and face it...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's why... could you please
guide me even more strictly?
choice_data_list: Got it. Let's aim for the top together again!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her demeanor as she smiled was so graceful,
as if her identity as a queen were quietly being rekindled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's get it back from here.
Let's make it even stronger. Her tsukkomi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that vow in mind,
I will rise again with Lucky Lilac—
